about: Holiday editions of the LR emblem, in school-year order. Read by the deck (deck/slides-lrhs.js), the case study and the brand guidelines page. Files live in public/images/lrhs-holidays; the SVGs are Bronx's exports from Downloads/SVG, byte for byte (scripts/check-lrhs-marks.mjs checks them). They are seasonal editions of the emblem, not extra marks, so they are not counted in lrhs-marks.json.
